title: 第十一章 禅心羊魅 道骨冤仇 屠道肆祸第十二章 阴墟鬼市 山精惑幻 阴阳颠倒一难
content_zh:
辞卧蛇荒寨，四神循西路逶迤而行。前番斩旱魃、除噬童蛇妖，四方神力愈发圆融，青龙守生、玄武镇地、朱雀焚邪、白虎肃杀，四象同心，道心愈发坚毅。一路山川渐阔，野径平缓，灾厄渐少，村落烟火袅袅，百姓安居乐业，四神心绪稍安，只稳步西行，不负救世天命。
行经数日，前路忽现连绵古岭，名曰万羊岭。山岭起伏连绵，漫山青草茵茵，溪流清冽，本该是牛羊遍野、祥和安乐之地，可四神甫入山岭地界，便觉一股诡异肃穆之气弥漫四野。无狂风、无阴煞，却遍染清净禅韵，又夹杂无尽血腥戾气，佛意澄澈与道士残魂怨念交织缠绕，阴阳相悖，正邪难分，怪异至极。
张忠东眉头紧蹙，朱雀灵杖微微震颤，沉声开口：“此地禅气浓郁，似有佛门修行道场，可底下血气浓重，亡魂不散，绝非寻常山林。佛道气息混杂相冲，必有大变故在此。”
王学南凝神掐算，卦象晦暗不明，福祸难辨，面色凝重无比，缓缓叹道：“卦象错乱，佛道相争，冤魂无数。岭中妖物皈依佛门，笃信佛法，却心性暴戾，嗜杀道门修士，往来道士，有来无回，尽数殒命于此。日积月累，道魂怨气滔天，佛韵压制冤孽，才成这般怪异景象。”
宁洋北闻言心神一凛，青木灵气漫山探查，只觉万羊岭深处，佛光隐隐普照，梵音断断续续回荡山间，可佛光之下，尽是道士骸骨、破碎道袍、断裂桃木剑、腐朽符箓，遍地残尸，道魂哀嚎不绝。他沉声肃色：“妖物信佛，却屠戮道门，颠倒黑白，悖逆天道。佛以慈悲渡世，道以清净安民，佛道本同源，岂能因一己恩怨，滥杀无辜修士？此妖心性偏执，罪孽深重，我等必入岭查探，理清恩怨，斩除祸根，超度万千枉死道魂。”
陈学西白虎利刃出鞘半寸，寒芒凛冽，周身杀伐之气悄然涌动，沉默颔首，已然做好迎战准备。
四人缓步深入万羊岭，沿途所见，愈发惊心。漫山青草翠绿，却处处沾染暗红血迹；林间古木葱郁，树下散落无数道士尸骨，白骨外露，衣衫破碎，符箓泛黄腐烂；山径两旁，道观破败倾颓，三清神像碎裂倒地，香火断绝，断壁残垣之间，皆是道士惨死痕迹。
偶有樵夫山民路过，见四神身着清逸道韵，神色惶恐，远远避让，不敢靠近。待四神上前询问，老者瑟瑟发抖，跪地哭诉，字字泣血。
“仙长千万莫要前行！万羊岭深处，有一头千年山羊妖，修成人身，一心礼佛，日夜诵经，虔诚无比，可它平生最恨道士，见一个杀一个，见一群灭一群！”
“数十年来，但凡有道门修士、观主道长路过此岭，或是上山祈福修行，必被那羊妖擒住，百般折磨，残忍斩杀。剥道袍、碎法器、灭道魂，尸骨随意丢弃山野，曝尸荒野，无人敢收。”
“先前周遭道观道长联手上山除妖，数十位得道高人，尽数被羊妖屠戮殆尽，无一生还。从此之后，天下道门无人敢踏足万羊岭，此地成了道士绝地，人人闻之色变。”
“那羊妖日日拜佛念经，慈悲满口，出手却狠辣无情。它说道士祸乱世间，邪魔外道，不配修行，不配存活，唯有佛门正宗，方能渡尽众生。佛心向善，妖行残暴，这般怪物，天地不容啊！”
老者哭诉完毕，连连叩首，哀求道：“仙长一身正道灵光，与道门同源，若是被那羊妖察觉，必定难逃一死！求仙长速速离去，莫要白白送命！”
四神听闻，皆是震怒不已。佛门讲究众生平等、慈悲不杀，道教讲究清净无为、顺天爱人，佛道本无高低善恶，皆是渡世法门。此羊妖假借礼佛之名，行屠戮杀戮之事，偏执疯狂，混淆正邪，枉害无数道门无辜修士，怨气堆积如山，实在罪无可赦。
宁洋北扶起老者，温声正色：“老人家不必担忧。佛道皆是正道，慈悲不分门派，善恶不分仙妖。此妖借佛行凶，滥杀道士，违背佛门本心，逆天而行。我等身负西行救世之责，纵然凶险万分，也要入岭除妖，超度枉死道魂，还万羊岭一片清明。”
张忠东怒火翻涌，朱雀圣火在杖尖熊熊燃烧，怒声喝道：“满口禅经，满心杀戮！借佛门之名，行嗜血恶事，这般伪佛妖邪，比恶鬼更为可恨！今日我必以纯阳圣火，焚尽妖邪，清算万千道债！”
王学南缓缓开口，剖析缘由：“此羊妖前世遭道士迫害，含恨而亡，转世成妖之后，一心皈依佛门，便认定所有道士皆是恶人，执念入魔，不分青红皂白，世代屠道。佛法未能度化它的戾气，反而助长它的杀心，千年修行，怨念越深，神通越广，羊角锋利无比，佛门佛光护体，道法难伤，极为难缠。”
陈学西冷声道：“执念成魔，不分善恶，留之必祸乱佛道两界，即刻上山，一战定生死。”
辞别山民，四人循着梵音方向，直奔万羊岭腹地。越往深处，禅音越盛，金光佛光笼罩山间，佛像虚影隐隐浮现，经文回荡不绝，一派佛门净土景象。可脚下白骨遍地，血腥味混杂青草气息，圣洁与血腥极致反差，令人毛骨悚然。
行至岭中高台，一座古朴石佛小院赫然现世。院中供奉金身佛像，香火长明，木鱼声声，梵音不绝。院中青石蒲团之上，一道白衣身影静静盘坐，双手合十，闭目诵经，周身佛光缭绕，圣洁无比，宛若得道高僧。

正是那千年白角羊妖。
此妖化为人形，身形清瘦，白衣胜雪，头顶一对洁白羊角，温润如玉，不沾凶戾；面容清秀慈悲，眉眼柔和，双目澄澈，周身佛光普照，禅意满身，看不出半分妖邪狰狞，反倒与世无争，慈悲渡世。谁也想不到，这般虔诚礼佛、一身禅韵的妖物，竟是屠戮无数道士、血染万羊岭的绝世凶煞。
羊妖缓缓睁眼，佛光褪去几分，清冷目光落在四神身上，毫无惊慌，只有无尽淡漠。它缓缓起身，双手依旧合十，声音温和清雅，宛若佛门高僧，缓缓开口：
“四位道友，一身道门清气，踏足万羊净土，可知此地规矩？”
宁洋北直视妖瞳，厉声质问：“你一心礼佛，朝夕诵经，信奉慈悲佛法，为何世代屠戮道门修士，残害无辜道长，尸骨遍野，冤魂满山？佛以不杀为本，你却嗜杀成性，假借佛名，作恶滔天，难道不怕因果报应，坠入无间地狱？”
羊妖闻言，淡淡一笑，笑意慈悲，眼底却藏着刻骨怨毒，缓缓诉说千年冤仇。
“百年之前，我本山野灵羊，静心修行，与世无争。山中道观道士，贪图我一身妖灵精气，无故擒我，剥皮抽筋，炼化道行，欲夺我修为成仙。我受尽万般折磨，魂飞欲散，侥幸残存一缕残魂，苟延残喘。”
“佛门慈悲，渡我残魂，重塑妖身，赐我佛法，让我得以存活，修成大道。自此我便知晓，佛门慈悲救世，道门阴险歹毒。天下道士，皆是害我仇敌，皆是邪魔外道，不配活在世间。”
“我日日礼佛，岁岁诵经，以杀止杀，屠尽天下道士，便是我此生佛念。杀尽恶人，清净世间，便是佛门功德。道士不死，祸乱不休，我便永生屠道，永不罢休！”
话音落下，羊妖周身佛光骤然暴涨，圣洁禅气瞬间化作凛冽杀气，温柔眉眼瞬间冰冷刺骨，头顶白角寒光暴涨，妖力冲天而起。
“尔等一身道韵，同属道门，今日踏入此地，便是自寻死路。乖乖受死，我念你们修行不易，留，你们全尸，超度你们亡魂，送入轮回。若是反抗，我便碎你们道基，灭你们神魂，让你们永世不得超生！”
宁洋北凛然不惧，沉声道：“前世恩怨，一人之过，岂能牵连天下道门？个别道士作恶，并非所有道长皆是恶人。佛道众生，皆是生灵，岂能一概而论，滥杀无辜？你被佛法度化，却被执念蒙蔽，以杀为禅，以恶为善，早已背离佛门本心，沦为妖魔！”
“巧言狡辩！”羊妖厉声呵斥，温和嗓音瞬间变得尖锐暴戾，“所有道士，皆同源同恶，无一清白！今日，我便连你们四人，一同斩杀，清扫道门余孽！”
话音未落，羊妖身形一闪，快如鬼魅，头顶雪白羊角裹挟无尽佛光与凌厉妖力，径直朝着宁洋北冲撞而来。羊角坚硬无匹，佛光护体，道法不侵，冲撞之势雷霆万钧，空气呼啸轰鸣。
宁洋北仓促闪避，青木青藤瞬间破土而出，密密麻麻缠绕羊角，欲束缚妖身。可佛光普照之处，青藤瞬间枯萎消散，青木生机竟被佛门金光尽数克制，毫无作用。
“佛门佛光克制道家五行灵气，诸位小心！”宁洋北厉声提醒。
张忠东立刻纵身上前，朱雀圣火滔天席卷，至阳烈火直冲羊妖而去。佛门佛光清净祥和，圣火遇佛光，竟无法灼烧妖身，反而被佛光缓缓压制，火焰渐渐黯淡。
羊妖冷笑一声，侧身避开火焰，羊蹄凌空横扫，蕴含千年妖力，狠狠砸向张忠东。张忠东猝不及防，被一击震退数丈，胸口沉闷，气血翻涌。
王学南连忙撑开玄武灵伞，厚重灵光护住众人，沉声道：“此妖佛妖同体，佛光护身，道法难伤，执念太深，寻常术法无法破局。它一生屠道，熟知所有道家法门，克制一切道术招式，万万不可硬碰硬！”
陈学西身形如电，白虎利刃寒光暴涨，杀伐剑意直冲羊妖七寸。利刃劈在佛光之上，金铁交鸣巨响震彻山岭，寒光尽数被佛光抵挡，无法伤及妖身分毫。羊妖反手一撞，羊角狠狠顶在利刃之上，陈学西虎口剧痛，长剑险些脱手，连连后退。

四人皆是心头一震。此妖太过诡异，信佛修禅，佛光万法不侵；千年羊妖，肉身强横无匹；熟知道门所有弱点，每一招都精准克制四象道法，佛妖双重神通叠加，远比寻常妖邪凶险百倍。
content_en:
After saying goodbye to Wo Snake Desolate Village, the four gods meandered along the west road. In the previous episode, the drought demon was slain and the child-eating snake demon was eliminated. The divine power of the four directions became more and more harmonious. The green dragon guarded life, the Xuanwu restrained the earth, the red bird burned evil, and the white tiger suppressed the evil. The four images were in the same heart, and the Taoist heart became more and more determined. Along the way, the mountains and rivers are getting wider, the wild paths are gentle, disasters are getting less and less, the villages are full of fireworks, the people are living and working in peace and contentment, the four gods are a little at ease, they just head westward steadily, living up to the destiny of saving the world.
After traveling for several days, a long stretch of ancient ridges suddenly appeared on the road ahead, named Wanyang Ridge. The mountains are rolling and rolling, covered with green grass and clear streams. It should have been a peaceful and peaceful place with cattle and sheep everywhere, but when the four priests entered the mountains and mountains, they felt a strange and solemn atmosphere pervading the surrounding areas. There is no violent wind, no evil spirits, but it is filled with pure Zen rhythm, mixed with endless bloody and violent energy. The clarity of Buddha's mind is intertwined with the resentment of Taoist priests' remaining souls. Yin and Yang are in conflict, good and evil are difficult to distinguish, and it is extremely weird.
Zhang Zhongdong frowned, the Vermillion Bird Spirit Staff trembled slightly, and said in a deep voice: "This place has a strong Zen atmosphere, and it seems to be a Buddhist practice, but the blood energy underneath is strong, and the souls of the dead are still lingering. It is definitely not an ordinary forest. The Buddhist and Taoist auras are mixed and conflicting, and there must be a big change here."
Wang Xuenan was concentrating on his calculations. The hexagrams were dark and unclear, and it was difficult to tell the good and bad. His face was extremely solemn, and he slowly sighed: "The hexagrams are in confusion, Buddhism and Taoism are competing, and there are countless innocent souls. The monsters in the mountains have converted to Buddhism and believe in Buddhism." Fa, but he was violent and murderous. Taoist monks came and went, and they all died here. Over time, the Taoist souls were full of resentment, and the Buddhist charm suppressed the injustice, which led to such a strange scene. "
Ning Yangbei's heart froze when he heard this, and he explored the mountains with green wood spiritual energy. He felt that deep in the Wanyang Ridge, the Buddha's light was shining faintly, and the Sanskrit sounds echoed intermittently in the mountains. But under the Buddha's light, there were all Taoist skeletons, broken Taoist robes, broken peach wood swords, decayed talismans, corpses everywhere, and Taoist souls wailing endlessly. He said solemnly: "The monster believes in Buddhism, but kills Taoists, confuses right and wrong, and rebels against the way of heaven. The Buddha saves the world with compassion, and the Tao brings purity and tranquility to the people. The Buddha and Taoism have the same source. How can it kill innocent monks indiscriminately because of personal grudges? This monster is paranoid and sinful. We will go to the mountain to investigate, sort out the grudges, eliminate the root of the evil, and save thousands of Taoist souls who died in vain."
Chen Xuexi's white tiger blade was half an inch out of its sheath. The cold light was piercing the air. Killing energy surged quietly around his body. He nodded silently, already ready for battle.
The four of them walked slowly deep into Wanyangling, and what they saw along the way became more and more shocking. The mountains are full of green grass, but stained with dark red blood stains everywhere; the old trees in the forest are lush, and countless Taoist priests' bones are scattered under the trees. The bones are exposed, the clothes are broken, and the talismans are yellow and rotten;
Occasionally, woodcutter and mountain people passed by and saw the four gods dressed in pure and elegant Taoist charms. They looked frightened and stayed away, not daring to get close. When the four gods came forward to ask, the old man was trembling, knelt down and cried, crying every word.
"Immortal, please don't move forward! Deep in the Wanyang Ridge, there is a thousand-year-old goat demon. It has cultivated into a human body. It devotes itself to worshiping the Buddha and chanting sutras day and night. It is extremely pious. However, it hates Taoist priests the most in its life. It kills one on sight and destroys a group on sight!"
"For decades, whenever Taoist monks or Taoist masters passed by this ridge, or went up the mountain to pray for blessings and practice, they would be captured by the sheep demon, tortured in every possible way, and brutally killed. The Taoist robes were stripped off, the magical weapons were broken, and the Taoist souls were destroyed. The bones were randomly discarded in the mountains and exposed to the wilderness, and no one dared to collect them."
"Previously, the Taoist priests from the surrounding Taoist temples joined forces to eliminate demons on the mountain. Dozens of Taoist masters were all slaughtered by the sheep demon, and no one survived. From then on, no one from the Taoist sect in the world dared to set foot on Wanyangling. This place has become a Taoist paradise, and everyone's expression changed when they heard about it."
"That goat demon worships Buddha and recites sutras every day. It is full of compassion, but its actions are cruel and ruthless. It has Taoist priests causing trouble in the world, and evil demons are heretics. It is not worthy of practice and does not deserve to live. Only the authentic Buddhism can save all living beings. The Buddha's heart is good, but the demon's behavior is cruel. Such a monster cannot be tolerated by heaven and earth!"
After the old man finished crying, he kowtowed repeatedly and begged: "The immortal has a long body."The spiritual light of the righteous path has the same origin as the Taoist sect. If the sheep demon detects it, he will surely die! Please leave as soon as possible, don't die in vain! "
When the four gods heard this, they were all furious. Buddhism emphasizes the equality of all living beings, compassion and non-killing, while Taoism emphasizes purity and inaction, obeying nature and loving others. There is no good or evil in Buddhism. They are all ways to save the world. Under the guise of worshiping the Buddha, this goat demon committed massacres and massacres. He was paranoid and crazy, confusing good and evil, and wrongfully harmed countless innocent monks from Taoist sects. His grievances piled up like mountains, and his crime was truly unforgivable.
Ning Yangbei helped the old man up and said in a gentle and serious tone: "Old man, don't worry. Buddhism and Taoism are all righteous ways. Compassion does not distinguish between sects, and good and evil do not distinguish between immortals and monsters. This monster uses Buddha to do evil, kills Taoist priests indiscriminately, violates the original intention of Buddhism, and goes against heaven. We are responsible for traveling westward to save the world. Even if it is extremely dangerous, we must go to the mountains to eliminate demons, redeem the Taoist souls who died in vain, and restore peace to Wanyang Mountains. "
Zhang Zhongdong's anger surged, the sacred fire of the red bird was burning on the tip of the staff, and he shouted angrily: "A mouth full of Zen sutras, but a heart full of killing! Using the name of Buddhism to commit bloodthirsty evil deeds, such fake Buddha evil spirits are more hateful than evil ghosts! Today I will use pure Yang holy fire to burn away all evil spirits and settle thousands of debts! "
Wang Xuenan spoke slowly and analyzed the reason: "This sheep demon was persecuted by Taoist priests in his previous life and died out of hatred. After he was reincarnated as a demon, he wholeheartedly converted to Buddhism and believed that all Taoist priests were evil people. He became obsessed with evil and indiscriminately slaughtered Taoists for generations. Buddhism failed to quell its hostility, but instead fueled its murderous intention. After thousands of years of practice, the resentment deepened and the magical power became broader. The horns of the ram were extremely sharp. The Buddha's light protected the body. Taoism and Taoism were difficult to damage and extremely difficult to deal with. "
Chen Xuexi said in a cold voice: "Obsession becomes a demon and does not distinguish between good and evil. If it remains, it will cause trouble in both the Buddhist and Taoist realms. Immediately go up the mountain and fight to determine life and death." "
Saying goodbye to the mountain people, the four of them followed the direction of Sanskrit and headed straight to the hinterland of Wanyangling. The deeper you go, the louder the Zen sound becomes, the golden light of the Buddha envelopes the mountain, the shadow of the Buddha statue appears faintly, and the scriptures echo endlessly, creating a Buddhist pure land scene. But there were bones everywhere under his feet, and the smell of blood was mixed with the smell of grass. The contrast between holiness and blood was horrifying.
Walking to the high platform in the middle of the ridge, a simple stone Buddhist courtyard suddenly appeared. There is a golden Buddha statue enshrined in the courtyard, with burning incense, the sound of wooden fish and the sound of Sanskrit. On the bluestone futon in the courtyard, a figure in white sits quietly cross-legged, hands clasped, eyes closed, chanting sutras, surrounded by Buddha light, extremely holy, like an enlightened monk.
It is the thousand-year-old white-horned sheep demon.
This demon has transformed into a human form, with a thin body, white clothes than snow, a pair of pure white horns on the head, as gentle as jade, not tainted with violence; a delicate and compassionate face, soft eyebrows, clear eyes, the Buddha's light all over the body, full of Zen, not a trace of evil and ferocious, but indifferent to the world, and compassionate in the world. No one could have imagined that such a monster who worshiped the Buddha devoutly and wore a Zen charm would actually be the unparalleled evil that slaughtered countless Taoist priests and stained Ten Thousand Yangling Mountains with blood.
The sheep demon slowly opened its eyes, the Buddha's light faded a bit, and its cold eyes fell on the four gods. There was no panic, only endless indifference. It stood up slowly, with its hands still clasped together, and its voice was gentle and elegant, like a Buddhist monk, and slowly spoke:
"Four fellow Taoists, with pure Taoist aura, have set foot in the Pure Land of Ten Thousand Sheeps. Do you know the rules of this place? "
Ning Yangbei looked directly into the demon eyes and asked sternly: "You wholeheartedly worship the Buddha, chant sutras day and night, and believe in compassionate Buddhism. Why have you slaughtered Taoist monks for generations, killed innocent Taoist priests, and left corpses everywhere and mountains full of innocent souls? The Buddha's principle is not to kill, but you are murderous and use the name of the Buddha to commit heinous crimes. Aren't you afraid of retribution and falling into the endless hell? "
When the sheep demon heard this, he smiled faintly, with a compassionate smile, but there was deep hatred in his eyes, and he slowly told the story of a thousand years of grievances.
"A hundred years ago, I was a wild sheep in the mountains. I practiced meditation quietly and had nothing to do with the world. The Taoist priests from the Taoist temple in the mountains, coveting my demon spirit, captured me for no reason, peeled my skin and cramped my muscles, refined my Taoism, and wanted to take away my cultivation and become an immortal. I suffered all kinds of torture, and my soul was about to disperse. Fortunately, a ray of my soul remained, and I was barely able to survive. "
"The compassion of Buddhism will save my remaining soul, reshaped the demon body, gave me the Dharma, allowed me to survive and cultivate the great path. Since then I have known that Buddhism is compassionate and saves the world, while Taoism is insidious and vicious. The Taoists in the world are all my enemies, they are all evil heretics, and they are not worthy of living in this world. "
"I worship the Buddha every day, recite sutras year after year, kill to stop killing, and slaughter all Taoist priests in the world. This is my Buddha's memory in this life. Killing all evil people and purifying the world is the merit of Buddhism. As long as the Taoist priests do not die and the troubles continue, I will slaughter Taoists forever and never give up! "
As soon as the words fell, the Buddha's light around the goat demon suddenly surged, the holy Zen energy instantly turned into a murderous aura, the gentle brows and eyes instantly became bone-chilling, the white horns of the head's head swelled with cold light, and the demonic power soared into the sky.
"You all share the Taoist spirit and belong to the Taoist sect. If you step into this place today, you are seeking your own death. Suffer death obediently. I remember that it is not easy for you to practice cultivation. I will keep your whole corpses to save your souls and send them to reincarnation. If you resist, I will shatter your Dao foundation, destroy your soul, and prevent you from reincarnation forever! "
Ning Yangbei was unafraid and said in a deep voice: "How can the grievances and grievances in the past life, one person's fault, implicate all Taoist sects in the world? Some Taoist priests do evil, but not all Taoist priests are evil. All living beings in Buddhism are living beings. How can we generalize them and kill innocent people indiscriminately? You were saved by Buddhism, but you were blinded by obsession. You regarded killing as Zen and evil as good. You have already deviated from the original intention of Buddhism and become a demon! "
"Whispering words! "The sheep demon scolded sternly, and his gentle voice suddenly turned sharp and violent, "All Taoist priests have the same origin and the same evil, and no one is innocent! Today, I will kill the four of you together to clean up the remnants of the Taoist sect! "
Before he finished speaking, the goat demon flashed as fast as a ghost. The snow-white horns on its head were wrapped with endless Buddha light and fierce demon power, and it rushed straight towards Ningyang North. The ram's horns are extremely hard, the Buddha's light protects the body, and Taoism is not intrusive. The force of the collision is thunderous, and the air roars and roars.
Ning Yangbei hurriedly dodged, and the green trees and green vines burst out of the ground in an instant, densely wrapped around the horns, trying to restrain the demon body. But where the Buddha's light shines, the green vines wither and dissipate in an instant, and the vitality of the green wood is completely suppressed by the golden light of Buddhism, without any effect.
"Buddhism's light restrains Taoism's five elements aura, please be careful! "Ning Yangbei reminded sternly.
Zhang Zhongdong immediately jumped forward, the Suzaku Holy Fire swept across the sky, and the Zhiyang Fire went straight towards the sheep demon. The Buddha's light in Buddhism is pure and peaceful. When the holy fire meets the Buddha's light, it cannot burn the demon body. Instead, it is slowly suppressed by the Buddha's light, and the flame gradually dims.
The sheep demon sneered, turned sideways to avoid the flames, and swept the sheep's hooves in the air, containing a thousand years of demon power, and hit Zhang Zhongdong hard. Zhang Zhongdong was caught off guard and was knocked back several feet by a blow. His chest felt heavy and his blood surged.
Wang Xuenan quickly opened the Xuanwu Spiritual Umbrella, and the thick spiritual light protected everyone, and said in a deep voice: "This demon, Buddha, and demon are one body, and the Buddha's light protects the body. It is difficult to be harmed by Taoism. The obsession is too deep, and ordinary magic cannot break it. It has slaughtered Taoists all its life, is familiar with all Taoist methods, and restrains all Taoist techniques. It must never confront anyone head-on! "
Chen Xuexi's figure was like lightning, the white tiger's sharp blade surged with cold light, and his killing sword intent went straight towards the sheep demon seven inches away. The sharp blade struck the Buddha's light, and the loud clang of gold and iron shook the mountains. All the cold light was blocked by the Buddha's light, unable to harm the demon at all. The sheep demon hit him with his backhand, and the horns of the sheep hit the sharp blade hard. Chen Xuexi's mouth was in severe pain, and he almost lost his sword and retreated continuously.
All four of them were shocked. This demon is too weird. It believes in Buddhism and practices Zen, and the Buddha's light is invincible. The thousand-year-old sheep demon has a physical body that is unparalleled. It is familiar with all the weaknesses of the sect, and every move accurately restrains the four-image Taoism. The dual magical powers of the Buddha and the demon are superimposed, which is a hundred times more dangerous than ordinary demons.
